title: VirtualBox: creating, configuring and tuning a VM

videos.script: VirtualBox is free, it runs on Windows, macOS and Linux, and it is what most people install the first time they want a virtual machine. So it is the one you will most often find on a customer's computer. {{first}} Making a machine in it takes a wizard and five decisions. A name and a type, memory, processors, a disk, and where the installer comes from. {{wizard}} Everything the wizard does can also be typed, with a program called VBoxManage. We will use it, because a typed command can be read back, checked and repeated. {{cli}} Then the settings that make a guest pleasant to use, and the ones that make it slow. And the small package that every guest needs, the Guest Additions. {{tune}} The computer this course is recorded on can configure VirtualBox machines but cannot start them. You will see exactly why, and it is a fault you will meet on real computers too. {{driver}}
